name: NASA POWER
detail: Global daily gridded weather. The release includes 34 exact-coordinate histories.

name: FAO / IIASA GAEZ v5
detail: 48 archived global model layers cover 24 crops, two water systems and low inputs for 2001–2020.

name: FAO / IIASA GAEZ country summaries
detail: FAO sample includes 178 wheat rows tagged at country level in one historical scenario.

name: FAO ECOCROP
detail: Catalogue and public search form verified. No bulk trait export documented there.

name: FAO AGROVOC
detail: English and Spanish terms retrieved by Skosmos. Languages and stable concept identifiers support search.
license: CC BY 4.0 for six FAO languages

name: FAOSTAT crops and livestock products
detail: 87 official national production records extracted for six countries. The unauthenticated data API returned HTTP 401.
license: CC BY 4.0 plus statistical database terms

name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
detail: Surface pH WCS worked at two recorded points. REST is paused. These are regional model estimates.

name: Open-Meteo / GeoNames
detail: Country-filtered Nairobi search returned coordinates. Public endpoint is for non-commercial use.

name: FAO Crop Calendar
detail: 58 countries returned. Verified country, crop and named-zone sowing windows in Kenya and Sri Lanka.

name: CGIAR Crop Ontology
detail: BrAPI v1 returned the wheat Grain number trait definition. Field thresholds require separate evidence.

name: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture CROPIX
detail: Gateway lists public and registered services. Production data access and reuse terms remain unverified.

name: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture
detail: Location- and cultivar-specific records support the Sri Lankan reference pack.

name: International Rice Research Institute
detail: Country-specific Rice Knowledge Bank material can support future manual review.

name: USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SSURGO)
detail: Verified spatial WKT query at Ames, Iowa (mukey=411285, Spillville loam). Restricted to US territories.

name: ISRIC WoSIS Standardized Soil Profiles
detail: WFS 2.0 GetFeature verified for ms:wosis_latest_phaq. Provides measured reference soil profiles, not farm-specific tests.

name: UCSB CHC CHIRPS v3.0 Precipitation
detail: Quasi-global (60°S–60°N) 0.05° (~5.5 km) satellite-gauge rainfall archive (1981–present). Never averaged with NASA POWER.

name: ECMWF ERA5-Land Reanalysis
detail: 0.1° (~9 km) hourly/daily land-surface reanalysis. Soil moisture is classified strictly as a reanalysis model estimate.

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 Elevation
detail: 90 m global digital elevation model used for regional altitude and slope context.

name: NASA GPM IMERG V07
detail: 0.1° half-hourly/daily satellite precipitation (2000–present). Requires NASA Earthdata Login token; not required on anonymous farmer path.

name: NASA SMAP L3/L4 Soil Moisture
detail: L3 (36 km / 9 km surface) and L4 (9 km root-zone model-assimilated). Requires NASA Earthdata Login; regional footprint cannot measure an individual field.
